_comment: Hints for tools/dev/mockup_promote.py (a mockup's Save writes the real implementation). A row finds its module property
by itself where it can: the target chain of its list, or the binding that feeds the module from a mockup-local
object. What it cannot find is said here, once, and a module author can move an entry into the row itself as
`promote: { to, map, skip }` -- the row's own hint wins over this file.
protected   directories the promotion never writes (the user's standing rules)
dynamic     per mockup: an expression the mockup gets at RUN TIME, named by the module type it holds
(silicon's `win._popup` is the live SiliconPopup; `win._director` etc. follow from it)
dressing    per mockup, "Type.prop": "Face": a font dressing the mockup does from a handler (phase fonts forces it)
owned       files that are one module's whatever their users say; shared: the other way round
(the shell frame mounts every module's owner: modules/shell/ShellFrame.qml instantiates them, which made each owner "shared with
another module" to the planner and Save SKIPPED their rows -- StocksBarOwner.popupWidth, the power reel's cellPitch -- from the F2 merge
on; the owners are one module's each, listed below, and a row of theirs is written again)
skip  not a shipped setting (the reason is shown in the panel)
to    "Type.prop" (or a list of them): the module property this row sets
map   the row's value -> the property's value: a list (indexed by the row) or an object

barParams.iconAlong.skip: stage placement: where the mockup stands the button on its bar

gridParams.iconAlong.skip: stage placement: where the mockup stands the button on its bar

gridParams.dressAudiowide.skip: the mockup's font dressing: the shell dresses every owner from shell.json's font (Audiowide), so the module's own face stays Inter -- the fonts phase is the user's call (STATUS.md, 2026-10-15)

barParams.iconAlong.skip: stage placement: where the mockup stands the button on its bar

lookParams.family.skip: an override the mockup's panel hands the module (familyOverride): silicon.json and the machine decide which family ships

lookParams.secondarySide.skip: an override the mockup's panel hands the owner (secondarySideOverride): the owner's own rule decides unless the host says

machineParams.*.skip: mock data: the machine the mock service pretends to be

memoryParams.*.skip: mock data: the memory the mock service pretends to have

kindParams.*.skip: osd.json owns the per-kind routes and times (the OSD's config file)

hostParams.spotBar.skip: the OSD's spot comes from osd.json

hostParams.spotAlong.skip: the OSD's spot comes from osd.json

cardParams.*.skip: the card reads its look through `look ? look.x : <literal>` fallbacks: there is no property default to rewrite

pillParams.*.skip: the pill reads its look through `look ? look.x : <literal>` fallbacks: there is no property default to rewrite
